design: stratified by system: 25 GT-decode + 25 PURE-decode (original evaluator), seeds 20260730
auditor: single auditor; consistency with the 50-item reference audit rules

EVENT.fn_note: regnet x5, mildere, feuchte+kalte, schauern, warnungen, unwetterwarnungen

key_finding: extractor recall is systematically LOWER on PURE hypotheses (0.83) than on GT hypotheses (0.91): donor-transcript-style outputs use more inflected verbs and compounds (regnet, unwetterwarnungen) that the lexicon misses. The same-extractor-applied-to-all argument does NOT establish strict cross-system unbiasedness; the bias direction understates PURE slot content, so the PURE>GT slot-F1 advantage is, if anything, underestimated.
